title: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Machine Orthodoxy

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The metal world Mirrodin, being turned into a Phyrexian homeland by the Machine Orthodoxy.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The white-mana faction of Phyrexia organized as a hierarchy of belief, led by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Praetor of Unity who leads the Machine Orthodoxy and secretly manipulates its dogma.

entities.name: Argent Etchings
entities.description: Written religious law and scripture scribed on a vast silver sculpture, interpreted by leaders and Praetors.

entities.name: Flesh Singularity
entities.description: A sect seeking to connect all beings into one organism and to remove the skin barrier.

entities.name: Izathel
entities.description: A high chancellor of a massive Phyrexian chancery in the planar core who sees all life as a single organism.

entities.name: Porcelain Legion
entities.description: A sect that idealizes the physical form, covering victims in porcelain-like metal.

entities.name: Apostles of Karn
entities.description: A sect restoring a centralized leader to Phyrexia, adopting Karn as their chosen leader.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem who created Mirrodin and whose corrupted mind is the seed of Phyrexia there; he is held on a throne by the Apostles.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The former focal leader of Phyrexia.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Source of the Phyrexian personality matrix Karn carries.

entities.name: Deep Faithful
entities.description: A sub-sect that tends the core's infrastructure and porcelain vats.

entities.name: Cenobites
entities.description: Priests in charge of the inquisition of non-Phyrexian life.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The native inhabitants of Mirrodin, reclaimed and compleated by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A layer of the Phyrexian core hiding Mirran resistance outposts.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin that fell quickly to the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Bladehold
entities.description: The last major Razor Fields fortress, an Auriok community not yet fallen.

entities.name: Accorders
entities.description: The once-roving civil force now serving as Bladehold's military.

entities.name: Ghalma the Shaper
entities.description: A loxodon artificer who turned a razor circle into a tunnel to the Furnace Layer.

events.summary: Karn flung himself to Mirrodin and surrendered his spark for Dominaria; his mind came unhinged and Phyrexia's influence grew in him.
events.quote: Karn flung himself to Mirrodin, the metal world he once created as Argentum, while simultaneously surrendering his planeswalker spark for the sake of the plane of Dominaria.

events.summary: A reborn Phyrexian civilization grew from the oil in Karn, who is trapped within it.
events.quote: Phyrexia did not invade Mirrodin; the Phyrexian civilization on Mirrodin developed from the corruption inside Karn

events.summary: The Apostles groom Karn on a Phyrexian throne and harvest his ravings as scripture, acting as jailers when he is lucid.
events.quote: the Apostles act as jailers, preventing his escape and traumatizing him back into submission.

events.summary: The Razor Fields fell quickly to the Phyrexians, scattering the leonin prides and isolating the loxodon.
events.quote: The Razor Fields fell to the Phyrexians quickly, scattering the leonin prides and isolating the loxodon.

events.summary: Bladehold's Accorders fight off Phyrexian assaults.
events.quote: now serve as Bladehold's military, fighting off Phyrexian assaults as best they can.

events.summary: Ghalma the Shaper turned a razor circle into a tunnel to the Furnace Layer refugee outposts.
events.quote: has turned a "razor circle"—a kind of crop circle carved magically in razorgrass—into a tunnel through Mirrodin's crust into the Furnace Layer.
